pros: Per-workspace pricing keeps cost flat as the team grows
WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger included as standard channels
Permanent free plan is usable for a solo founder
Native apps for iOS, Android, macOS and Windows
REST API, webhooks and JavaScript SDK for user data
cons: No ticket lifecycle or SLA management
Reporting is thin compared with a help desk
AI agent cannot run multi-step actions against backend systems
verdict_line: Pick Crisp if you want chat, email, WhatsApp and social in one inbox for a small team without paying per seat.

pros: Chatbot books meetings on the right rep's calendar
Identifies target accounts on site and alerts reps
Playbooks show different flows to named accounts
Mature Salesforce, HubSpot and Marketo integrations
cons: No ticketing, SLAs or knowledge base for support work
Annual, quote-based contracts priced for sales organisations
Standalone roadmap uncertain since the Salesloft acquisition
verdict_line: Pick Drift if the website chatbot's job is booking sales meetings with target accounts, not resolving support tickets.

pros: Measured on resolved conversations, not deflections
Performs backend actions such as order or account changes
One agent configuration runs across chat, email and voice
Dozens of languages served from a single knowledge base
Governance includes audit logs, SSO and pre-release testing
cons: Requires a separate help desk for human agents
Sales-led annual contracts sized for high-volume enterprises
Implementation takes weeks and a dedicated owner
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Ada if you need an enterprise AI agent that resolves millions of conversations across chat, email and voice on top of your help desk.

pros: WhatsApp, Instagram and Apple Messages in one inbox
Free plan covers website chat for a small team
Bot builder can call APIs and pass context to agents
Freddy Copilot summarises threads and drafts replies
Shares contacts and reporting with Freshdesk and Freshsales
cons: Freddy AI Agent sessions are a metered add-on
Packaging overlaps with Freshdesk Omni and confuses buyers
SLAs and advanced reporting only on upper tiers
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Freshchat if you already run Freshdesk and want WhatsApp, social and in-app chat with a bot from the same vendor.
